title_sq: Apartament 3+1+2 Poste Parkimi ne Shitje te Lake View Residence Tirane
description_sq:
Kompleksi Residencial Lake View, prane liqenit artificial, disponojme per shitje Apartament 3+1+2, me siperfaqe totale 197.1 m2. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 9 dhe organizohet ne soxhorno, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, depo, korridor, ballkon dhe verande. Apartamenti shitet se bashku me 2 poste parkimi ne katin -2, me siperfaqe respektive 40.22 me dhe 42.63 m2.
Shitet 700000 Euro i diskutueshem (630000 pa garazhet)
title_en: Apartment 3+1+2 parking spaces for sale in Lake View Residence Tirana
description_en: Lake View Residential Complex, near the artificial lake, we have for sale Apartment 3+1+2, with a total area of ​​197.1 m2. The apartment is located on the 9th floor and is organized in living room, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, storage room, corridor, balcony and veranda. The apartment is sold together with 2 parking spaces on the -2nd floor, with a surface area of ​​40.22 m2 and 42.63 m2, respectively. For sale 700000 Euro negotiable (630000 without garages)
